svg.title: Deployment pattern diagram

g.title: FX Web Shop places orders FX Order API
FX Order API reads and writes orders FX Orders Database
FX Order Worker consumes order messages FX Order API
FX Order API publishes order placed FX Order Worker
FX Web Shop shares session state FX Session Cache
FX Edge Gateway routes customer traffic FX Web Shop
FX Order API checks own health FX Order API
FX Order API charges cards FX Payment Provider
FX Order API posts ledger entries FX Shared Ledger
FX Order API sends notifications FX Unplaced Notifier
FX Legacy Cart reads historic carts FX Orders Database
g.text: reads historic carts / PostgreSQL wire protocol · SQL 5432

g.title: FX Order Auditor administers orders FX Order API
g.text: administers orders / gRPC 8443 → gRPC 8092 via FX Public Load Balancer

g.title: FX Order Auditor reviews storefront orders FX Web Shop
g.text: reviews storefront orders / https 443 → http 8080 via FX Public Load Balancer

g.title: FX Web Shop forwards partner orders FX Partner Portal
g.text: forwards partner orders / https 443 → https 443 → http 8080 via FX Web Firewall via FX Public Load Balancer

g.title: FX Legacy Cart archives carts FX Order Archive
FX Legacy Cart replays legacy orders FX Order API
FX Order API session-read FX Session Cache
